name: odeget
setup: o = odeset('RelTol', 1e-9, 'AbsTol', 1e-12, 'MaxStep', 0.05); o3 = struct('Foo', 1, 'RelTol', 2); or_ = struct('reltol', 3);
expr: rt = odeget(o, 'RelTol'); at = odeget(o, 'abstol'); ms = odeget(o, 'MaxStep'); jp = odeget(o, 'Jacobian', 42); pfx = odeget(o, 'Rel'); pfx2 = odeget(o, 'MaxS'); low = odeget(o, 'rel'); foo = odeget(o3, 'Foo'); rt2 = odeget(o3, 'RelTol'); wrongcase = odeget(or_, 'reltol'); canonmiss = odeget(or_, 'RelTol', 42); emptyo = odeget([], 'RelTol', 7); valdef = odeget(o, 'RelTol', 42); strname = odeget(o, "RelTol");
covers: odeget(opts, name, default)      fall back to default when field empty
odeget(opts, name, default)      fall back to default when field empty
odeget([], name[, default])       empty options -> default/[]
comment: Sig 1+2: odeget(o, 'RelTol') and odeget(o, name, default). MATLAB normalises name to canonical capitalisation, returns the stored value if non-empty, else the default. Empty Jacobian field falls through to 42 here. Argcheck portion 2026-09-19 resolution model (probed R2025b): an EXACT case-sensitive field of opts wins outright (foreign fields included); otherwise the name case-insensitively prefix-matches the 21 canonical options (no match = invalid name even with a default; ambiguous = error; empty name = ambiguous); a canonical match whose exact-case field is absent falls to the default. String-scalar names accepted; struct arrays read element 1 (nk: struct arrays themselves unsupported - engine gap, documented in the portion memory).
